Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Sachin Shankar Magadum
 Oral Judgment
(PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SACHIN SHANKAR MAGADUM)
The present appeal, filed under Section 74(1) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013, challenges the judgment and award dated 30.01.2023 in LAC No.2530/2020.
However, the appeal is filed after a delay of 77 days beyond the statutory limitation period of 120 days prescribed under Section 74(1) of the Act.
Relying on precedents, including Union of India vs. Popular Construction Co. and State of Kerala vs. V.R. Kalliyanikutty reported in AIR 1999 SC 1305, the NC: 2024:KHC-K:10192 appeal is dismissed as time-barred, without addressing the merits.
